about.heading:
A Corporate Group Built
for Tanzania
body: We are a Tanzanian corporate group with diversified interests across key sectors of the economy, committed to creating value through disciplined investment and professional management.
Our experienced leadership team combines financial expertise with deep market knowledge to identify and develop opportunities that deliver lasting returns.

items.body: M&A advisory, corporate restructuring, and strategic planning for businesses and institutions.

items.title: Financial Services

items.title: Real Estate
items.body: Commercial and residential property investment, development, and asset management.

items.title: Trade & Commerce
